title: Saturated denotation quotients construct HF sets with exact hereditary closure

statement.quantifiers: Every finite transitive actual HF family U with one node per object, separate atom predicate and exact membership/reflexive hereditary closure; fixed-arity candidate rows theta(v,u),v in V.
statement.assertion: Old/new descriptors quotient to exactly U union {b_v:v in V},b_v={u in U:theta(v,u)}, with at most |U|+|V| semantic nodes and exact stored hereditary closure, without choosing representatives or arbitrary reachability.
assumptions: Old-old equality is actual equality; new-new compares all membership rows; new-old requires Set(old) and equal rows.
Saturate every coordinate of retained and newly constructed relations before quotient.
New candidate sets contain only old objects; U is transitive.
Parameter-free fixed tuple tags require at least two input atoms at startup.

inputs: Exact semantic old representation, fixed-arity V and FO candidate-membership formula.
outputs: Atom-safe extensional set constructor preserving exact E and C on the quotient.
interface.precision: Exact denotation, not approximate hash/row identity or descriptor-count semantics.
costs: Fixed tuple encoding dimension and formula width are charged constants; core startup is3D before the separate binary2D normalization.
No choice oracle, generic HF reachability or direct raw-descriptor Hartig count.

proof_mechanism: Separate atoms from sets so an empty membership row does not identify atoms with Empty.
Prove descriptor equality by actual denotation; saturate all old/new relations before quotient.
Represent old-to-new closure by exists old z with C_old(x,z) and theta(v,z); add reflexive descriptor identity.
Transitivity means a downward path from a newly created set immediately enters the old domain, so existing C suffices.
Use equality-pattern tuple tags and fixed padding instead of selected atoms.
obstructions: Bare membership-row extensionality collapses atom and Empty.
Unsaturated old labels or new tables can depend on representatives.
Restriction to a nontransitive kept subset leaves stale closure.
No generic construction from parameter-free empty/singleton tuple universes.

potential_uses.transfer_gate: Maintain transitivity, atom/set separation, all-coordinate saturation and object-count rather than descriptor-count semantics; use the separately scoped binary normalization.

review.source_reported: Source independent internal reconstruction and semantic finite checks reported; no independent ingestion proof reconstruction, scientific replay, external correctness or priority clearance.
